transcript.text: lg w/d keeps saying dE n wont start?? door is shut

I can't confirm what DE means on your model, so I'll go by what it is doing. From what you have described, the most likely cause is the door lock (interlock). Is the door physically stuck shut, or does it close normally but the machine won't start - and is there still water in the drum?
it closes normally, not stuck. just wont start, theres a click then nothing. no idea about water, its got a king size duvet in it
Is the display lit at all, and do some buttons work while others don't — or is the whole machine dead with no lights?
display is lit, just shows dE. buttons seem to work, its not dead
Open the door, make sure nothing is caught in the seal, then close it firmly until it clicks and start a programme. Does the door click locked now?
checked the seal, theres a corner of the duvet squashed in it. closed it again but it springs back a bit, no proper click i think. still dE

From what you have described, the most likely cause is obstruction / trapped clothing / overload / alignment (won't close). With the machine unplugged, look at the small hook (catch) on the door and the slot it goes into, and check the door lines up squarely when you close it. Is the catch broken, bent or the door dropped on its hinge, was something blocking it (now cleared), or does it all look fine?
hook looks fine, not broken or bent. its just the duvet bulging against the glass n squashing in the seal
If it's stuck shut: is the drum empty and does the handle feel normal or loose/floppy? If it won't start: does the door seem to lock when you press Start?
its not stuck shut, it just wont start. doesnt seem to lock properly when i press start, just the click then dE
Next: Check a control-lock/child-lock isn't on and the programme isn't paused. Let me know what you find.
no idea how to check that, how do i see if child lock is on? it only happens with the duvet tho, normal loads start fine

On most LG washing machines, look for a small padlock icon on the display or press and hold the 'Spin' button (or sometimes 'Temp') for three seconds to toggle it off. If the machine starts normally with other loads, the child lock is likely not the cause of this specific issue. Many machines have a child lock (often a key or padlock symbol, turned off by holding two buttons together for a few seconds — your manual shows which) that keeps the door and buttons locked. Was the child lock on (and is it off now), or was it already off?
not sure, i havent tried holding any buttons. its only the duvet that does it tho, normal loads start fine, so can u just tell me whats wrong?

The issue is that the door seal is not closing properly because the large duvet is preventing it from latching securely. This prevents the safety interlock from engaging, which stops the machine from starting as a safety measure. Next: Check for a child/control lock (padlock symbol) and turn it off. Let me know what you find.
